Role Title: AI Conversation Evaluator

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote – Global (English required)

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay: $45–70/hour

Time commitment: Approximately 7.5 hours total

Project kickoff: Sunday, November 15

Project duration: Short-term project, expected to run through November 18

You'll need: An active personal ChatGPT account (Free or Plus), access to a computer or smartphone, and availability during the project window.

Your tasks: Interact with different versions of an AI assistant through everyday conversations, compare the overall experience, and provide structured ratings and brief written feedback.

About the role

AI assistants are becoming part of everyday life, helping people with everything from writing emails and planning trips to answering questions and solving problems. We want to understand how natural, helpful, and enjoyable these interactions feel from the perspective of real users. That's where you come in.

You'll test different AI experiences using your own ChatGPT account, engage in everyday conversations, and share your feedback on what worked, what didn't, and which experience you preferred.

What you'll do

  1. Engage in a series of natural, multi-turn conversations with different AI assistants.
  2. Use everyday scenarios such as writing, planning, researching, brainstorming, or asking questions.
  3. Compare AI responses and select your preferred experience.
  4. Evaluate conversational quality, helpfulness, clarity, tone, and overall user satisfaction.
  5. Identify behaviors that feel unnatural, repetitive, or unnecessary.
  6. Provide short written feedback highlighting positive and negative moments.
  7. Follow simple testing guidelines and document your evaluations accurately.

Who we're looking for

  1. Active ChatGPT user, using the platform at least 3 times per week.
  2. Must have a personal ChatGPT Free or Plus account.
  3. Comfortable interacting with AI assistants for everyday tasks.
  4. Detail-oriented, with the ability to follow instructions and provide thoughtful feedback.
  5. Clear written communication skills; English proficiency preferred.
  6. Available to participate between November 15–18.
  7. Generalists welcome; no specific professional background required.
  8. No coding or previous AI evaluation experience needed.

Why you'll like it

  1. Get paid to use and evaluate AI tools you're already familiar with.
  2. Work remotely, with flexibility during the project window.
  3. Participate in a short-term project with competitive hourly compensation.
  4. Have a direct impact on improving the quality and user experience of conversational AI.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply: Submit your application and confirm your availability.
  2. Complete the screening questions: Share your ChatGPT usage frequency and account type (Free or Plus).
  3. Interview: A short interview, if required, to confirm your eligibility.
  4. Profile review: If everything looks good, we present your profile to the client.
  5. Onboarding: Our Talent Ops team will contact you with instructions to get started.
